activity_summary: In the afternoon, while the Shrew went on without you, you left the messenger's half-line empty and wrote the women's sentence under it. A twelvemonth and a day. The words he would have said are still not there. Foul paper, not a finished act.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the sentence around the blank and did not fill the blank.
